newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the pound.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the pound.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr weakened against the pound on Tuesday, the central bank said.
The bank posted a birr mean rate of 9.9021 against the pound on Tuesday from 9.8957 on Monday.
The birr was a touch firmer against the mark at a mean of 4.2029 from 4.2040 on Monday. Against the yen, it was dealt at a mean of 0.058041 compared to 0.058025 on Monday.
Following the currency auction on September 21, the central National Bank of Ethiopia has fixed a birr-dollar rate of 6.37 for the September 23 and 29.
